meta.description: The Social Element type tree from Philosophia Socialium et Operis: rooted at the abstract Social Element — whose type of order is the Social Order — and expanded into agents, agencies, intentions, actions, relations, norms, coordinators, structures and dynamics.

nodes.name: Social Element
nodes.def: A concept denoting an element participating in the association-oriented and coordination-oriented dimension of collective life experienced by humans or other purposeful agents. The organized association side: units, agencies, actions, relations, norms, coordinators, structures, and dynamics through which agents hang together.

nodes.name: Interaction Unit
nodes.def: Bounded entity capable of interaction: agentive, cognitive/reflexive, relational, nested, state-carrying.

nodes.name: Social Actor
nodes.def: An interaction unit considered as a participant in collective life under common authority; every instance resolves to exactly one side of the partition. `Social` names the interactional dimension; `Societal` below names of-society-as-opposed-to-state.

nodes.name: State Actor
nodes.def: Actor constituted by public authority, wielding delegated sovereign power or executing a public mandate.

nodes.name: Societal Actor
nodes.def: Actor constituted outside public authority.

nodes.name: Agency
nodes.def: Structured capacity to form intentions, select actions, control execution, and integrate feedback.

nodes.name: Individual Agency
nodes.def: Agency exercised by a single interaction unit: the locus of personal intention and choice.

nodes.name: Joint Agency
nodes.def: Agency constituted by two or more units jointly committed to a shared intention: irreducibly plural, never the sum of individual agencies.

nodes.name: Collective Agency
nodes.def: Agency exercised by a compound unit through its decision architecture.

nodes.name: Intention
nodes.def: Intentional structure: the formation and holding of goals, ends, and commitments directing agency.

nodes.name: Problematization
nodes.def: Apprehended gap between conditions and a norm, and the process of forming it; the social form of problematization (cf. the epistemic process).
ex: Inflation framed as monetary vs supply-driven

nodes.name: Deliberation
nodes.def: Weighing of ends, means, and alternatives toward a commitment.

nodes.name: Decision / Choice
nodes.def: Punctual resolution of deliberation into an owned commitment.

nodes.name: Goal
nodes.def: Desired future state coordinating effort: the object an intention takes.

nodes.name: Objective / Target
nodes.def: Formalized, measurable specification of a goal.

nodes.name: Collective / Organization
nodes.def: Compound unit with identity, membership, and rules.

nodes.name: Organizational Unit
nodes.def: Structured actor with internal rules and identity, scoping departments within a collective.

nodes.name: Social Action
nodes.def: Causally efficacious relational event between units: interaction, solitary-social, mediated, institutionalized, collective.

nodes.name: Activity
nodes.def: Coarse bundle of granular social actions performed as one situated doing.

nodes.name: Technical Activity
nodes.def: Coarse bundle of granular technical actions: research, development, transfer, operation, maintenance.

nodes.name: Action Guidance
nodes.def: Guidance structure: coordinators that orient, license, and constrain subsequent action.

nodes.name: Strategy
nodes.def: Deliberate selection of ends and means over a horizon, coordinating action across agents.

nodes.name: Policy
nodes.def: Deliberate course of action adopted by an authority, guiding subsequent decisions.

nodes.name: Principle
nodes.def: General rule or standard guiding and evaluating action.

nodes.name: Rule
nodes.def: Explicitly codified constraint prescribing or prohibiting conduct.

nodes.name: Doctrine
nodes.def: Authoritative body of guiding tenets orienting action in a domain.

nodes.name: Framework
nodes.def: Organizing lens and architecture structuring perception and action in a domain; operative (transformation designs) or analytic (grammars for reading change).

nodes.name: Action Organization
nodes.def: Organization structure: forms arranging actions into coordinated wholes across agents and time.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.def: Deliberate arrangement of future actions specifying ends, means, and sequence.

nodes.name: Program
nodes.def: Coordinated set of projects pursued under one objective.

nodes.name: Project
nodes.def: Time-bounded organized effort toward a defined outcome.

nodes.name: Workflow
nodes.def: Defined sequence of steps routing work among actors and roles.

nodes.name: Schedule
nodes.def: Temporal allocation sequencing actions, agents, and resources.

nodes.name: Initiative
nodes.def: Bounded undertaking launched to pursue a new objective.

nodes.name: Roadmap
nodes.def: Sequenced long-range outlook aligning planned moves with milestones.

nodes.name: Charter
nodes.def: Founding instrument constituting an organized effort and its mandate.

nodes.name: Agenda
nodes.def: Prioritized set of actions and initiatives ordered for collective attention and pursuit.

nodes.name: Action Instrumentation
nodes.def: Instrumentation structure: operative means coordinating and controlling execution — instruments wielded by agencies to steer, monitor, and enforce organized action.

nodes.name: Interaction Pattern
nodes.def: Recurring relational sequences shaped by protocols, scoping repeated exchanges.

nodes.name: Allocation
nodes.def: Distribution of scarce goods by rule, scoping who receives what.

nodes.name: Behavior
nodes.def: Observable pattern of actions over time, scoping an agent's conduct.

nodes.name: Social Relation / Network
nodes.def: Structured tie between units; kinship, alliance, exchange, hierarchy.

nodes.name: Institution
nodes.def: Stabilized configuration of roles and rules.

nodes.name: Social Role
nodes.def: Expectation-tag binding actor, context, and interpretation to behavior.

nodes.name: Power Relation
nodes.def: Asymmetric dependence stabilized into positional advantage.

nodes.name: Link
nodes.def: Minimal dyadic connection composing a network.

nodes.name: Supply Chain
nodes.def: Chain of exchange ties from source to sale.

nodes.name: Pair
nodes.def: Minimal dyad stabilized by mutual recognition.

nodes.name: Norm / Regulation
nodes.def: Shared protocol stabilizing interaction: building-block and emergent.

nodes.name: Right / Obligation
nodes.def: Deontic positions allocating claims and duties.

nodes.name: Legitimacy
nodes.def: Recognized warrant of authority.

nodes.name: Authority
nodes.def: Legitimated power to command and be obeyed.

nodes.name: Convention
nodes.def: Stable coordination pattern sustained by mutual expectation, not enforcement.

nodes.name: Cultural Script
nodes.def: Semantically rich behavior protocol.

nodes.name: Symbolic System
nodes.def: Full set of labels and interpretive frames used by a collective.

nodes.name: Status
nodes.def: Relative standing recognized by a collective.

nodes.name: Jurisdiction
nodes.def: Bounded domain of legitimate authority.

nodes.name: Polity
nodes.def: Political community organized under a common authority.

nodes.name: Regime
nodes.def: Stable pattern of political rule.

nodes.name: Governance Structure
nodes.def: Arrangement through which authority and coordination are exercised.

nodes.name: Collective Decision Mechanism
nodes.def: Procedure for making collective choices.

nodes.name: Interest
nodes.def: Stake in an outcome attributed to a unit.

nodes.name: Constraint
nodes.def: Limitation on action recognized in coordination.

nodes.name: Incentive
nodes.def: Arrangement shaping behavior toward an outcome.

nodes.name: Habitus
nodes.def: Durable dispositions shaping perception and action.

nodes.name: Belief / Expectation
nodes.def: Shared anticipations coordinating behavior.

nodes.name: Value / Ideology
nodes.def: Evaluative coordinators binding collectives.

nodes.name: Collective Representation
nodes.def: Symbolically carried image of the group to itself.

nodes.name: Collective Identity
nodes.def: Shared interpretive frame binding actors into a we.

nodes.name: Collective Mental Model
nodes.def: Shared stabilized schema guiding perception and action.

nodes.name: Discourse
nodes.def: System of statements shaping perception and action.

nodes.name: Narrative
nodes.def: Structured interpretation of events over time.

nodes.name: Symbol
nodes.def: Meaning-bearing sign coordinating recognition.

nodes.name: Language
nodes.def: Communication system enabling coordination.

nodes.name: Medium
nodes.def: Channel through which coordination flows.

nodes.name: Knowledge
nodes.def: Validated information used by actors in coordination.

nodes.name: Tagging System
nodes.def: Semantic labeling rendering states legible; the Noetic primitive.

nodes.name: Social Compound
nodes.def: Bounded collective scoping a decomposition; the generic compound type.

nodes.name: Social Structure
nodes.def: Constraint topology delimiting the admissible region of collective state space.

nodes.name: Environment
nodes.def: Fundamental (geography, resources) and derivative layers conditioning action.

nodes.name: Region
nodes.def: Spatially bounded zone of dense recurrent interaction.

nodes.name: City
nodes.def: Spatially and institutionally organized local nexus.

nodes.name: Province
nodes.def: Higher-order territorial aggregation with coordination functions.

nodes.name: Class
nodes.def: Positional differentiation by access to resources.

nodes.name: Hierarchy
nodes.def: Ranked ordering of positions.

nodes.name: Social Field
nodes.def: Arena of interaction governed by specific logics.

nodes.name: Domain
nodes.def: Functional sphere of social activity.

nodes.name: Infrastructure
nodes.def: Foundational enabling system.

nodes.name: Resource
nodes.def: Asset usable by actors.

nodes.name: Property
nodes.def: Attribute used for description, classification, and comparison.

nodes.name: Wealth
nodes.def: Accumulated stock of valued resources.

nodes.name: Rent
nodes.def: Economic return from a position or asset.

nodes.name: Process / Event
nodes.def: Temporally extended transformation or punctual occurrence.

nodes.name: Mechanism / Phenomenon
nodes.def: Emergence-to-collapse trajectories: diffusion, escalation, stabilization, realignment.

nodes.name: State
nodes.def: Complete relevant-variable snapshot of a configuration at a moment.

nodes.name: Social Event
nodes.def: Significant occurrence involving actors.

nodes.name: Systemic Transformation
nodes.def: Structural change of an order via interactions.

nodes.name: Crisis
nodes.def: Rupture threatening reproduction of an order.

nodes.name: Cycle
nodes.def: Recurrent expansion–contraction trajectory.

nodes.name: Corruption
nodes.def: Conversion of office into private gain.

nodes.name: Crime
nodes.def: Norm-violating act processed by control institutions.

nodes.name: Violence
nodes.def: Coercive harm between units.

nodes.name: Polarization
nodes.def: Sorting of a collective into opposed camps.

nodes.name: Globalization
nodes.def: Extension of ties and flows beyond borders.

nodes.name: Mobility
nodes.def: Movement of units across positions and places.

nodes.name: Movement
nodes.def: Collective effort pursuing social or political change.

nodes.name: Work
nodes.def: Purposive effort transforming inputs.

nodes.name: Socialization
nodes.def: Induction of newcomers into norms.

nodes.name: Segregation
nodes.def: Sorting of units into homogeneous zones.

nodes.name: Competition
nodes.def: Rivalry for scarce goods or positions.

nodes.name: Technical Change
nodes.def: Diffusion and adoption of techniques.

nodes.name: Synontic Element
nodes.def: Recognition-constituted coordinator persisting through shared interpretation.

nodes.name: Capital / Labor
nodes.def: Multi-layer economic operators (potentiality and actuality of productive capacity).

nodes.name: Price / Asset
nodes.def: Scalar coordination variables and claim-objects.

nodes.name: Trust
nodes.def: Willingness to be vulnerable based on expectations of another.

nodes.name: Money
nodes.def: Medium of exchange and store of value constituted by recognition.

nodes.name: Label
nodes.def: Tagging that reclassifies its bearer.

nodes.name: Technique
nodes.def: Shared know-how coordinating production.

nodes.name: Economic Activity
nodes.def: Recurrent organized doings provisioning goods and services (Ontic).

nodes.name: Producer
nodes.def: Acting unit or role performing economic activity (Ontic).

nodes.name: Producer Type
nodes.def: Kind of producer by dominant activity (Noetic tag).

nodes.name: Industry
nodes.def: Classified aggregate of producer types under a common activity (Noetic).

nodes.name: Sector
nodes.def: Coarse activity group (Noetic).

nodes.name: Producer Taxonomy
nodes.def: Descriptive instrument ranking producer types (Noetic).

nodes.name: Market
nodes.def: Arena where offers meet demand and prices coordinate (Multi).

nodes.name: Market Segment
nodes.def: Slice of a market by demand characteristics (Noetic).

nodes.name: Subsegment
nodes.def: Finer slice within a segment (Noetic).

nodes.name: Niche
nodes.def: Narrow slice served by a specialized offer (Noetic).

nodes.name: Market Taxonomy
nodes.def: Descriptive instrument classifying markets (Noetic).

nodes.name: Product
nodes.def: Exchangeable outcome of economic activity offered into a market; a good or service (Multi).

nodes.name: Product Type
nodes.def: Kind of product, narrowest rank above the concrete product (Noetic).

nodes.name: Product Family
nodes.def: Family grouping related types (Noetic).

nodes.name: Product Category
nodes.def: Market-facing category (Noetic).

nodes.name: Product Class
nodes.def: Broadest rank (Noetic).

nodes.name: Product Taxonomy
nodes.def: Descriptive instrument ranking product kinds (Noetic).
